3: Set in the 22nd century, The Matrix tells the story of a computer hacker who joins a group of underground insurgents fighting the vast and powerful computers who now rule the earth.

A world of wonders in one great picture!

What's a little murder among friends?

More than the legend will survive.

In a world of tradition. In an age of innocence. They dared to break the rules.

The man who has everything has everything to hide.

I'd rather be happy now than in 25 years.

The Loveable Bug's back doin' his thing!

A CARTOON FIESTA of FUN and FANTASY!

Taking out the trash, one jerk at a time.

HIS PARADISE BECAME A MERRY HELL!

...and this is how SHERIDAN TOOK GRANT!

It was supposed to be a simple heist.

My whole life I’ve known nothing but animals.

An American corporation, the Mexican cartel, chances are this won't end well.

HE was more than a cop. SHE was more than a thief.

She was lucky that Mr. Skeffington was such a gentleman!

The entertainment that loves a lot, and lives a lot, and gives and gives and gives a lot.

She thought she was a rebel... Until she met a real one

YES, this is a beautiful American girl in the arms of a Japanese boy!

America's finest moment in the world's greatest game.

If you want to take him down, you better bring backup.
The Voice / Harry / Mercenary Leader / Bartender (voice)

Every life is a universe all its own.

It's never too late to love life again.

Out here, you're the endangered species...

Trapped on a Train of Terror!

Who knows the truth about the curse of Captain Clegg?

Dancer in 'Humne Pe Rakhi Hai' song

Dedicated to the proposition that every pretty girl receives sooner or later!

Hidden love! Hidden hate! Hidden fear!

Shah of Iran, Mohammad Reza Pahlavi

Inspector Merryweather, Hong Kong Marine Police

Hero to 30,000,000... Thrilling on the Screen!
38659: A professional witness at the marriage registrar helps a runaway girl when her boyfriend does not show up for the wedding. He falls in love with her, but then the missing groom returns.

When life is perfect, what's to question?
39171: True story of three British POWs and their attempt to escape from Nazi Germany
39427: Financial wizard "Doc" Fletcher is sent by crime boss Joe Fiore to buy a bank in Switzerland in order to more easily launder their profits. They were after silver and they struck gold.

Dr. Stockmann decides to fight to get the word out to the people, but receives as very mixed reaction.
The tragedy of a an honest man destroyed by a town's greed.

Grim Reaper / Gardener / Swordsman / Monster / Old Duke (voice)

The officer - guest of honor - الضابط - ضيف شرف

At the rate of the murders, Kennedy's character reveals itself more and more and sinks into a spiral that seems to have no way out.
Some ghosts refused to stay buried

The latter must also juggle his stormy relationship with glamorous circus star Flo Lorraine.
FOR THE MILLIONS WHO CHEERED "THEY DRIVE BY NIGHT"!

She finds herself being dragged into a world not only foreign in language but completely outside her cultural values. Her only savior is the one person who does not rely on language for communication, a deaf artist.
44547: A jealous barber's assistant becomes enraged by the attentions the manicurist he's obsessed with and a repeat customer pay to one another.

What if your personality began to crumble… who would you become?

A world under attack.  A hero battling to change destiny.

Eventually their irreverent personalities will put them in a situation that is too big for them to handle.

Many heroic stories will come out of this war ... but there will never be a greater one than this !

48387: Following an unproductive harvest season, it’s up to Maya and her brave friends to save their hive by competing in a series of games.
The sweetest adventure of the year!
48643: Americans investigating the results of nuclear radiation discover a man-eating monster on a remote island.
A Brutal Orgy of Ghastly Terror!
48899: A young man moves to a new town after experiencing a tragedy and becomes involved with a gang of Satan-worshipping teens who believe they have supernatural powers. But by the time he realises he’s in too deep, it may be too late to escape.

Old Lady of Ma Por Inn

Don Manuel de Godoy "Príncipe de la Paz"

The stories of poor people living in a neighborhood in Athens and their difficulties.

All the glory of a man is nothing but a short dream.

You think you know about the Range Rover murders...Think again.

Savage by savage...they fought out of a deadly Apache torture trap!
